_comment: Passed to `aws dms create-endpoint --s3-settings`. Placeholders {{...}} are substituted by scripts/setup_ingestion.sh from config.env.

_notes.IncludeOpForFullLoad: Adds the Op column (I/U/D) to full-load rows too, so bronze has ONE unified schema across full load + CDC. Full-load rows get Op='I'.
_notes.TimestampColumnName: Emits `ingested_at` = commit timestamp for CDC rows, load time for full-load rows. This is your batch/partition watermark.
_notes.DatePartition*: Writes objects under .../schema/table/YYYY/MM/DD/ so downstream Spark reads can prune by day.
_notes.CdcPath: Full-load files land at BucketFolder/schema/table/; ongoing CDC files land under BucketFolder/cdc-changes/schema/table/ — keeps the immutable initial snapshot separate from the append-only change log.
